policy: Source readiness is fail-closed. A source is publication-ready only after authoritative payload identity/acquisition, immutable byte hashing, observed schema/semantics, temporal interpretation, evidence-backed geography, rights review, privacy review, and validation are all satisfied. Metadata pages, successful probes, titles, names, or green CI never substitute for these requirements.

OGD_NFHS5_DISTRICT_FACTSHEETS_2019_2021.blocker: Official resource identity is known, but authoritative workbook bytes have not yet been admitted as a verified immutable payload in repository evidence.

OGD_HMIS_JH_DISTRICT.blocker: The authoritative resource page is snapshotted, but no explicit authoritative schema-bearing CSV payload has been admitted. District aggregates must never be allocated to villages or facilities.
